title: Render after reviewer claim in CONTRIBUTING step 8
lead: CONTRIBUTING step 8 re-renders the roadmap right after the reviewer claims the item, so the claim commits cleanly.
findings_note: CONTRIBUTING.md:120: reviewer runs 'slicer next --status review --start' which does not re-render; committing the claim then fails 'slicer check' (hit on ob-02 and ob-09 reviews). Add 'slicer --root .worktrees/ob-NN render' after the claim.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing slicer itself; other CONTRIBUTING steps.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `slicer next --status review --start` changes tracking state without re-rendering, so `slicer check` reports a stale render until someone runs `slicer render`. Reviews of ob-02, ob-09, ob-17, and ob-08 all hit this.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: None; documentation only. Following step 8 as written leaves `slicer check` failing with "stale render" after the claim.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: In step 8, add `slicer --root .worktrees/ob-NN render` directly after the `next --status review --start` claim in the reviewer's command block.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Claim a review-status item by following step 8 literally, then run `slicer --root .worktrees/ob-NN check`; it passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit for the doc change plus the `.slicer/` changes.
